reviews.t: Works great. The conditioner really makes a difference
reviews.x: Works great.  The conditioner really makes a difference.  3 months of taking pills and I didn't notice anything.  1 use and my hair was thicker when it was still wet.  I highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: Smells nice but no heavy perfume
reviews.x: I have a closet full of half-used shampoos and conditioners; these are the first products I've used all the way through and bought again and again, at least in many years. I started buying it on Amazon because finding it in stores has been hit or miss. The conditioner is always the key for my hair (kind of limp, smooth hair, I guess), and this one is not too heavy, not too light. Smells nice but no heavy perfume.

reviews.t: Shampoo
reviews.x: I love the shampoo but didn't mean to order the conditioner....I thought I was ordering (2) two bottles of shampoo; my hair is fine and this shampoo makes a difference.

reviews.t: hair growth
reviews.x: worked for my hair which was falling out and now has stopped,hair feels thicker and fuller

reviews.t: True to it's name...
reviews.x: I've been using this product for over 5 years with excellent results!  My hair line has moved back about an inch and my crown scalp shows when my hair is wet.  And the rest of the top of the hair is showing some thinning as well.  When I use any other shampoo/conditioner it is noticeable.  But Thicker Fuller Hair actually makes my hair totally filled in.  I look maybe 20 years younger...  The scent is nice too.  It's kind of a herbal citrus.  It doesn't have a medicinal smell, nor a feminine one

reviews.t: Best shampoo for baby fine hair!
reviews.x: Best shampoo for my baby fine hair. Cant get two hairs to do the same thing!  Can a shampoo change your life? This has, for me. You would never know this thick, gorgeous hair with body is 100% from this shampoo. I spent too many years with flat nothing hair laying flat on my scalp. I hate when I have to use another shampoo, so I stocked up on these two packs.

reviews.t: Did not make my hair thicker. VERY DISAPPOINTED
reviews.x: Didn't work for me. I used it every time in the shower until the bottles were empty and I did not see any improvements. I have thinning hair and I did not see any noticeable differences. For those who expect the shampoo and conditioner to make their hair to look fuller and to improve/reverse the signs of thinning hair, DO NOT BUY THIS! Save your money

reviews.t: Why must I buy the conditioner?
reviews.x: Shampoo is great, but binding the order with conditioner implies the conditioner is necessary for thickening. Not only is it not, but it made my hair worse than if I had not used the shampoo. It implies as well that the binding of the products is a monetary decision. Will likely return to other shampoos that are equally effective.

reviews.t: Good product
reviews.x: This is a good duo if you have fine or thin hair.  It's not quite as good as some of the more expensive products but works for me.  12 oz bottles last forever.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product makes their hair feel thicker or fuller.
Some reviewers report no thickening or improvement, even after using the bottles up.
